commands.title: Pause Agent Access to Browser Tab
Resume Agent Access to Browser Tab
End Agent Control of Browser Tab
Share Browser Tab with Agent Session…

enumDescriptions: Ask before an agent session reads or controls a browser tab you opened (once per tab, or per site).
Let every agent session use browser tabs you opened without asking.
Never let agent sessions use browser tabs you opened; they work in their own tabs.
agentBridge.browser.userTabs.description: Whether agent sessions may use integrated-browser tabs that you opened. Tabs an agent opened itself are always available to it.

agentBridge.browser.leaseIdleSeconds.description: How long an agent session keeps control of a browser tab without acting in it. After that the tab's indicator disappears and another session may take control.

agentBridge.browser.pageIndicator.description: Show a small indicator in the page (and a thin frame in the session's color) while an agent session controls a browser tab, with a button to take over.
